name: Antoine Gademer
biography: is a last year PhD student in the ATIS (Data and Signals Acquisition and Processing) laboratory at ESIEA Paris. He is obtained is ESIEA engineer's degree in 2005 and a Paris-Est University Geographic Information System's degree in 2006. He is specialized in aerial and satellite image processing and more recently in sensor integration.
